speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.dusty.0: You've half the road on you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.dusty.1: Shake yourself off before you come in.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.dusty.2: Long way on foot, was it?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.dusty.green.0: Dust on you. Good, you walk like one of us.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.dusty.green.1: Road's on your boots. Where've you been?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.dusty.green.2: Hah. Not so clean now, soft-skin.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.muddy.0: Mind your boots, I've just swept.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.muddy.1: Did you crawl here through a bog?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.muddy.3: There's a well in the square. Use it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.muddy.green.1: You've been in the marsh! Catch anything?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.muddy.green.2: Mud keeps the bugs off. Smart.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.filthy.0: Gods, you're caked in it. Stay back.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.filthy.1: I can't even tell what colour your clothes were.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.filthy.2: Were you buried and dug up again?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.filthy.3: Wash before you speak to me again.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.dirt.filthy.4: Look at the state of you!
Now THAT is how a warrior should look.
You look like you've lived. Good.
